name: sets
description: Search Rebrickable LEGO sets by keyword, theme_id, year range, or part count range. Returns set number, name, year, part count, theme, and image URL. Use `themes` to get valid theme IDs.

name: set
description: Fetch a single LEGO set by `set_num` (e.g. "75192-1") from Rebrickable. Returns set name, year, theme, part count, and image URL.

name: set_parts
description: Fetch the full parts list for a LEGO set by `set_num` from Rebrickable. Returns each part's part_num, name, color, quantity, and image URL.

name: set_minifigs
description: Fetch the minifigures included in a LEGO set by `set_num` from Rebrickable. Returns each minifig's set_num, name, quantity, and image URL.

name: parts
description: Search Rebrickable LEGO parts by keyword, color_id, or part_cat_id. Returns part number, name, part category, and image URL. Use `colors` or category list to get valid IDs.

name: part
description: Fetch details for a single LEGO part by `part_num` from Rebrickable. Returns part name, category, material, and image URLs across available colors.

name: themes
description: Return the complete list of LEGO themes from Rebrickable (e.g. Star Wars, Technic, City). Returns theme id, name, and parent_id. Use to get valid theme_id values for filtering `sets`.

name: colors
description: Return the complete list of LEGO colors from Rebrickable with color id, name, RGB hex code, and is_trans flag. Use to get valid color_id values for filtering `parts`.
